en.tour.release-what-changes.step1.title: What users get

en.label.hintRequirementState.draft: being written, not agreed; nothing is built against it
en.label.hintRequirementState.agreed: a person agreed a revision; no linked issue has started
en.label.hintRequirementState.delivered: every linked issue is closed; an approver accepts the delivery
en.label.hintRequirementState.deferred: out of the current release; nothing is planned or built against it until a person undefers it
en.label.hintBcVerdict.passing: every issue criterion tracing to this wording has a pass verdict
en.label.hintBcVerdict.failing: an issue criterion tracing to this wording failed its latest verdict
en.label.hintBcVerdict.stale: issue criteria trace only to an earlier wording of this criterion
en.label.hintBcVerdict.not_judged: an issue criterion tracing here has no verdict yet
en.label.hintBcVerdict.gap: no issue criterion traces to this criterion
en.label.hintRevisionState.proposed: waiting for a person to accept or return it
en.label.hintRevisionState.superseded: replaced by a later accepted revision
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.new: not triaged; a person picks a route
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.triaged: the route's carrier died, and a person routes it again
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.planned: an issue, revision or requirement carries it
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.resolved: the linked work shipped; waiting on the reporter to verify
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.reopened: the reporter says it is not fixed; back to triage
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.verified: a person confirmed the fix; never automatic
en.label.hintFeedbackPhase.declined: not doing it, with a reason the reporter sees
en.label.hintReleaseState.draft: merged issues wait at the release gate and no version holds them yet
en.label.hintReleaseState.in_progress: a release run is promoting, deploying or verifying the version
en.label.hintReleaseState.awaiting_approval: no production act is taken until an admin approves
en.label.hintReleaseState.returned: an admin sent it back with a reason; the master answers before it asks again
en.label.hintReleaseState.shipped: the release run stamped the version released
en.label.hintReleaseState.failed: the release run ended without shipping
en.label.hintReleaseState.aborted: the release run was stopped on purpose
en.label.hintIssueStatus.draft: not accepted as work yet; a person decides
en.label.hintIssueStatus.open: accepted, no run yet; a master takes it
en.label.hintIssueStatus.reopen: sent back with a reason; a master takes it again
en.label.hintIssueStatus.in_progress: a run holds it; its step is the progress
en.label.hintIssueStatus.approved: the plan checkpoint; the next run goes straight to build
en.label.hintIssueStatus.needs_info: waiting on a person to answer
en.label.hintIssueStatus.awaiting_release: every criterion passed; waiting for the release
en.label.hintCriterionStanding.pass: the latest verdict passed (or passed short of the wording, judged not to block)
en.label.hintCriterionStanding.skipped: judged and skipped with a reason; never counts as a pass
en.label.hintCriterionStanding.unresolved: a backfilled verdict named an abbreviated commit that never resolved
en.label.hintDesignStatus.draft: the master is still drawing it
en.label.hintDesignStatus.proposed: nothing that builds it is dispatched until an approver approves it
en.label.hintDesignStatus.approved: work that builds it may start
en.label.hintDesignStatus.returned: sent back to the master to revise
en.label.hintDesignRevisionState.proposed: waiting on its approver to approve or return it
en.label.hintDesignRevisionState.current: the approved revision work builds against
en.label.hintDesignRevisionState.returned: sent back with a reason; the master revises it
en.label.hintDesignRevisionState.superseded: a later revision replaced it, approved or proposed in its place

vi.tour.release-what-changes.hint.new: Màn này mới: trang release mở đầu bằng những gì người dùng nhận được. Xem nhanh {count} bước?

vi.tour.release-what-changes.step1.title: Người dùng nhận được gì
vi.tour.release-what-changes.step1.body: Từng thay đổi như người dùng sản phẩm sẽ đọc, theo tên, nhóm như changelog: Thêm mới, Thay đổi, Đã sửa.
vi.tour.release-what-changes.step2.title: Chi tiết kỹ thuật
vi.tour.release-what-changes.step2.body: Mở mục này để xem release được xây thế nào: các bề mặt được deploy, thay đổi cần để ý trước khi duyệt, và thiết kế không deploy gì.
vi.tour.integrations.title: Tích hợp
vi.tour.integrations.hint.new: Màn này mới: Integrations báo đúng những gì Forge kết nối được. Xem nhanh {count} bước?
vi.tour.integrations.hint.updated: Màn này mới đổi. Xem nhanh {count} bước để biết trạng thái và nút Connect nằm ở đâu?
vi.tour.integrations.step1.title: Trạng thái thật
vi.tour.integrations.step1.body: Mỗi dòng nói Forge thực sự kết nối được gì. Kho mã không có kết nối nào tới được thì hiện Chưa kết nối, không còn hiện Đã kết nối nữa.
vi.tour.integrations.step2.title: Kết nối ngay tại đây
vi.tour.integrations.step2.body: Mỗi dòng chưa kết nối có nút Connect. Với repo GitHub, nút này cài GitHub App.
vi.tour.integrations.step3.title: Dùng chung một connection
vi.tour.integrations.step3.body: Một connection project khác đang có có thể dùng chung cho project này, chọn nó phục vụ việc gì.
